dialogues.speaker: Haiyue
dialogues.text: To be precise, I'm here for work, but I've already done everything I need to do.

dialogues.speaker: Haiyue
dialogues.text: I may be a sailor who roams the world, ever ready to embrace new adventures, but there are still a few places I regard more fondly than most.

dialogues.speaker: Haiyue
dialogues.text: This place is probably my second favorite place in the world after my home. Life here goes on at a relaxed pace, and the people are also carefree and friendly.

dialogues.speaker: Haiyue
dialogues.text: I got myself a membership card at the Golden Dusk after my first time here. Now, I help out the owner with some goods and repairs whenever I can. Also helps that she'll always give some discounts.
